mapper.select: SELECT id, title, author, publisher, price, published_at AS publishedAt, genre, page, image, is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM book WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pd.quantity), 0) AS totalPurchaseCount, COALESCE(SUM(pd.quantity * b.price), 0) AS totalSalesAmount FROM payment pd JOIN book b ON pd.book_id = b.id WHERE b.id = #{bookId}
SELECT ratings, COUNT(id) AS count FROM review WHERE book_id = #{bookId} GROUP BY ratings ORDER BY ratings

SELECT p.id AS paymentId, p.account_id AS accountId, p.book_id AS bookId, p.quantity, b.price AS price, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM payment p JOIN book b ON b.id = p.book_id WHERE p.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY createdAt DESC
